digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration — AWS Bedrock native support
propositions: Rebar has no native Bedrock provider path; clients reach Claude through Bedrock more often than the direct Anthropic API, forcing deployment of an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy that sacrifices prompt caching and native structured output.

Prompt caching on Bedrock fails silently for some model IDs (observed: us/global opus-4-5 variants report zero cache read/write tokens while billing full input every call), requiring a cache-ineffectiveness warning when cache_read and cache_write are both zero despite being requested.

Some Bedrock model IDs reject the temperature sampling parameter with a 400 ValidationException (measured: us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7), causing hard failures on Pass-2 verification steps that deliberately set temperature=0 for greedy determinism, whereas the direct-Anthropic path gracefully degrades.

On-demand Bedrock model IDs are not invokable in the measured account/region; only inference-profile ARNs work, requiring documented default to be a regional inference profile (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 verified to cache).

Story f184 shipped BedrockModelSettings with exactly two cache keys (bedrock_cache_instructions, bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the Anthropic path, deliberately omitting bedrock_cache_messages; the native Bedrock builder must construct models using exactly these two keys.
